description: REMARKS paragraph — a pre-1985 comment paragraph that NO held edition has: the CODASYL Journal of Development 1968 deleted it (§1985:A.2.5 item 8), the X3.23-1985 Identification Division general format (§1985:VI.3.2.1.1) prints only PROGRAM-ID, AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED and SECURITY, and ISO 2002 and later print none of the comment paragraphs. The grammar still recognizes it so every edition refuses it by name (COBOL0902) and --permissive keeps a migrated program compiling with a warning (kb/Work PB5026). Its window is empty: removed at the first held edition.
citation: absent from the X3.23-1985 Identification Division general format (§1985:VI.3.2.1.1), deleted by the CODASYL Journal of Development 1968 (§1985:A.2.5); absent from ISO 2002 and later; VCR Table 7
